# Sunrise Residency — synthetic sample data

**Everything in this folder is fictional.** Sunrise Residency does not exist. Names, tokens, balances and expenses were generated by a script; phone numbers are masked placeholders and vendor contacts are dummies. No resident or society data from any real pilot is included.

| File | Shape |
|---|---|
| `ledger.csv` | 11 flats × 9 months. Follows the ledger invariant `balance = opening + expenses − received + adjustment`; September is the open month |
| `residents.csv` | Identity records as they look after tokenisation (ADR-013): opaque token, flat, role, masked phone |
| `vendors.csv` | Example knowledge-base document for the RAG path |
